prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an illustrated THREE-HIT BASIC COMBO SEQUENCE for a game design document, faithfully based on the user's hand-drawn pose sketch. Image 1 is the mandatory ACTION AND POSE reference, showing Kaze J1, J2, J3. Image 2 is CHARACTER IDENTITY AND ART STYLE reference; use ONLY Kaze, the first character. Kaze is the tall lean bald adult male jade-green monk, completely shaved head, sleeveless wrapped jade robes with light green cloth panels, dark green trousers ending above ankles, simple wrist/ankle wraps, BARE FEET with exposed toes. Preserve his adult face and outfit from the reference; no headband, no hair, no armor, no shoes.

Create a clean wide panoramic landscape storyboard with THREE equally sized panels reading left to right, all figures full body, all FACING RIGHT in a consistent SIDE VIEW suitable for a lateral fighting game. Neutral warm off-white backdrop with one fine ground baseline and very subtle vertical column separators. Polished hand-painted stylized game concept rendering, coherent anatomy and consistent proportions/costume between all three poses. Preserve the user's simple movement silhouettes instead of inventing acrobatics. Small title exactly "KAZE / COMBO BÁSICO". Above the panels, large clear labels exactly "J1", "J2", "J3". At bottom of each panel use only the short labels specified below. Restrained thin cyan/emerald motion arrows make the user's intent clear; NO elaborate VFX, no giant wind tornadoes, no environmental scene, no opponents, no extra poses, no cropped feet.

LEFT PANEL J1 — "PALMA FRONTAL": match the first stick figure: stable broad stepping stance, rear leg extended diagonally backward, lead leg forward with bent knee, torso mostly upright. Lead arm extends horizontally to the RIGHT with a clearly OPEN PALM facing right, fingers pointing up, wrist vertical, palm heel forward. Rear arm bends with its hand chambered low near waist. Small RIGHTWARD arrow at open palm, short curved mint motion arc. This is a PALM STRIKE, not a closed fist punch.

CENTER PANEL J2 — "DUAS PALMAS": match the center stick figure: supporting foot on the ground, the other knee lightly lifted/bent forward, upright torso. BOTH forearms reach forward toward the RIGHT in front of the torso, hands open, one at lower-chest level and the other at waist/abdomen level, as two palm strikes at different heights. Depict a small vertical double-ended movement arrow beside the hands, echoing the user's UP/DOWN blue arrow and word Palma. Do not turn this into hands clasped together, a prayer pose, a projectile or a magical spell. Keep the two palms visually distinct and naturally connected to two arms. This is the visual interpretation of the sketched palm motion; avoid extra story or mechanics.

RIGHT PANEL J3 — "CHUTE FRONTAL": match the last stick figure: one supporting leg bent with its foot on the baseline, the OTHER leg extended STRAIGHT HORIZONTALLY toward the RIGHT at about hip height in a front kick. The bare kicking foot is clearly visible; toes up and sole facing right, a small RIGHTWARD arrow below the foot. Torso upright, one arm extended forward around shoulder height for balance, the other bent with hand near hip. No jumping, no airborne flying kick, no roundhouse, no raised knee replacing the straight kick.

Keep the sheet illustrative and usable to brief an animator. The three panels represent THREE CONSECUTIVE DISTINCT ATTACKS, not startup/active/recovery of one attack. Avoid numerical timing, damage stats or invented effects. Make the exact requested movements unmistakably clear, while keeping all figures anatomically plausible and the design true to Kaze v2.
